claim: Natural scheduling revisits each stream under the stated reliable-feedback model.
main_evidence: Structural theorem plus DARE and top-N loss checks.
boundary: Requires the paper's stabilizability, observability, and reliable-feedback assumptions.

claim: Reset-based SCO improves adaptation after synthetic model drift.
main_evidence: Thirty seed clusters with paired problem instances and frozen confidence intervals.
boundary: Controlled simulator evidence; recent comparators are matched adaptations, not official reproductions.

claim: The controlled ranking persists on UZH-FPV and M3ED replay inputs.
main_evidence: Episode-level computational replays and paired trace addenda.
boundary: Reused public flights are not independent physical trials or a field deployment.

claim: In-flight-aware PA-SCO reduces duplicate transmissions under two-way delay.
main_evidence: Fixed-delay and seven-profile random-delay paired evaluations.
boundary: Robustness stress only; no global or random-delay optimality claim.

claim: The implementation exposes explicit model-mismatch and certificate limits.
main_evidence: Multi-axis, constant-acceleration mismatch, and certificate sweeps.
boundary: Independent-axis CV generalization and empirical proxy calibration only.
